notes.title: Out of Line's Third Update!

tags.bug: [*] Fixed several bugs and visual glitches throughout the game;
[*] Fixed an issue with skipping certain puzzles that could cause syncing problems;
[*] Fixed an issue with claws detecting San but not attacking;
[*] Fixed issue with sound not stopping or not restarting properly

notes.title: Out of Line's Second Update!

tags.bug: [*] Fixed several bugs and visual glitches throughout the game;
[*] Fixed several collision issues on elevators;
[*] Fixed issues with San being able to enter certain walls;
[*] Fixed issue with spiders not attacking San, when not under the light.

notes.title: Out of Line First Update

tags.bug: Fixed bug with the meta achievement “Out of Line” not triggering - reentering the game should unlock the achievement if the remaining achievements are unlocked;
Fixed a bug where the lever tutorial could be ignored;
Disconnecting a controller should now pause the game.
Opening the overlay should now pause the game.

tags.feature: Out of Line now includes a controller recommended configuration.
